rules: https endpoints, or plain http only to loopback/local hosts
credentials only as one whole $LADE_PROVIDER_* variable resolved from the laded environment or credentials.env; literal keys only for local endpoints
no !command values, no other environment interpolation, no oauth blocks
ids must not redefine a provider with a reviewed LADE policy or credential mapping
egress is allowed to exactly the declared host:port (private addresses only for local endpoints)

resources.context_files: supported: LADE profile AGENTS.md, then the worktree root's own context file in pi order (AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, AGENTS.MD, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.MD)
resources.prompt_templates: supported: LADE profile prompts/, expanded once by pi
resources.extensions: supported with approval: LADE profile extensions/, approved by sha256 content hash, re-verified by the worker
resources.repository_pi_dir: restricted: repository .pi/ resources are not loaded (untrusted repository content)
resources.system_md: restricted: SYSTEM.md / APPEND_SYSTEM.md are not loaded; LADE's system note is the only addition
resources.themes: restricted: no terminal themes in the GTK client
resources.packages: restricted: pi packages (npm/git installs) are not installed or loaded
resources.settings_json: restricted: global/project settings.json are not read; settings are in memory
